intro: StorageCafe has no industry-statistics page for Boise. Its listings page puts the non-climate 10x10 average at $137/month (September 2026). Storage Stats puts the Boise metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $110, down 3.3% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $162. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe listings non-climate averages; no industry-statistics page); no StorageUnitCosts city page; Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe listings non-climate average $52 (Sep 2026). Only one published figure for this size. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$96. Non-climate listings from about $30 (Oct 2026).

Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe listings non-climate average $80 (Sep 2026). Only one published figure for this size. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$108. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. Listings-page non-climate average $137 (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). No industry-statistics street-rate page for this city. Storage Stats Boise metro non-climate asking rent $110, down 3.3% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Boise alone. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$162. Non-climate listings from about $93 (Oct 2026).
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe listings non-climate average $155 (Sep 2026). Only one published figure for this size. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$244.

Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe listings non-climate average $199 (Sep 2026). Only one published figure for this size. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$195. Non-climate listings from about $60 (Oct 2026).

local_tips: StorageCafe's listings page names Pioneer (~$117) among the lower-priced areas.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
